# Real DigiNet frames, read from a Control|24 (firmware 1.08, desk MAC 00:a0:7e:a2:0f:d0)
# on the Ethernet port of the host that drove it. Each line is "name hex". The comment above a
# line gives the capture file and the packet's number in it (tcpdump, ether proto 0x885f).
#
# desk_* frames were sent by the desk: they are the independent witness of the grammar.
# host_* frames were sent by libdiginet and the desk acknowledged them: they show what the
# desk takes, not what a vendor host sends.
#
# tests/ksy/check_wire.py reads them with the parser generated from protocol/diginet.ksy.
# desk_e0_cold: ackonly.pcap packet 1
